mechanism: GQ(q,q) incidence retained; arbitrary simple r-regular internal graph on each side

formula.type: average over all roots in one bipartition side; necessary only

max_degree_relaxation.scope: Allow arbitrary simple internal graphs of maximum degree at most r on each side. The same average U bound remains valid; parity is not an obstruction to this larger scope.
max_degree_relaxation.proof: The CA far route total is 2*m_P*q^2 <= N*r*q^2. All other upper bounds already use degree upper bounds only.

important_open_case.detail: Each side has 585 vertices. An internal graph may have one degree-2 vertex and 584 degree-3 vertices. Exact 3-regular parity failure does not exclude this maximum-degree template.

existing_profile.verification: root independent all-312-root BFS already completed; not rerun
existing_profile.scope: two finite internal-2-factor search starts only, not all 2-regular internal choices

positive_routing_basis: Retaining all GQ incidence edges keeps every opposite-side pair within 3 and every collinear same-side pair within 2, and gives full D<=4. Far same-side pairs are the only D3 obligation.
